title: Unified-Agent capability catalog
description: Canonical evidence-backed capability catalog and ledger. One authoritative structured representation; rendered views are generated from this file. See docs/capability-catalog/README.md for the update procedure and verification limits.

as_of.description: ISO date the catalog facts were checked against source and, where possible, live state.

source_baseline_sha.description: Commit SHA of the local source baseline the code/test evidence was read against (short or full).

origin_main_sha.description: Commit SHA of origin/main at check time; equal to source baseline when the catalog was built on current main.

live_hub_checked_at.description: ISO datetime (UTC) of the last live read-only check against the canonical hub (task_list / profile_status / vault captures). 'not performed' is an honest value.

verification_limits.description: Explicit statements of what this catalog could NOT verify (missing live probes, unavailable tools, stale references).

update_instructions.description: Step-by-step instructions a future agent follows to refresh this catalog without interpreting this conversation.

families.description: The ten required capability families. Every catalog item must belong to exactly one family id.

pilot.description: True for the five high-value families the first slice proves the schema on.

items.description: Every capability. Each item carries all required fields; classification, consumer, evidence, boundary, and freshness are mandatory.

queue_coverage.description: Existing queue items this catalog must not duplicate (acceptance criterion 6). Live status at the freshness date.

traceable_paths.description: At least five representative items traced capability -> consumer -> behavior evidence -> owner/task or explicit closure decision (acceptance criterion 7).

family.description: Must match a family id in families[].

implementation_state.description: Allowed classifications from the task spec. Code presence alone is never 'shipped-and-used'.

consumer.description: Named consumer workflow, tool, or human surface; use the literal value 'no verified consumer' when none is known.

ref.description: Exact tool name, CLI command, route, module, or file path.

note.description: How a caller actually reaches it. Empty string is allowed when not-applicable.

connection_state.description: Never inferred from code or config alone; records the live evidence actually obtained.

type.description: code=source seam, test=local/CI test run, ci=CI pipeline, deployed=deployment claim, live=live authenticated probe result.

date.description: ISO date when the evidence was produced. REQUIRED for type=live; recommended for all.

incomplete.description: Required when implementation_state is not 'shipped-and-used' or 'superseded' with a closure decision; the validator enforces this.

task_ref.description: Live queue task id or decision ref, or null.

decision.description: Existing decision or explicit closure, or null.

wedge.description: Whether the capability strengthens the evidence/control wedge or belongs to an expansion slice.
